dedupe_keys.name: com droughts drought indices daily spi3 et pet and m7q for 52 swiss catchments under ch2018 scenarios 1991 2099

description: COM-DROUGHTS gives daily catchment time series of three drought indicators, SPI3 for meteorological, relative evapotranspiration ET/PET for agricultural and seven-day mean streamflow M7Q for hydrological drought, for 52 lower-lying Swiss catchments (mean altitude under 1500 m) from 1991 to 2099. The Zenodo record says they derive from the CH2018 climate and Hydro-CH2018 hydrological scenarios, with 8, 16 and 20 GCM-RCM chains for RCP2.6, 4.5 and 8.5, plus catchment, calibration and model chain information files. It was published in 2024 by Christoph von Matt and colleagues (University of Bern, MeteoSwiss and ETH Zurich), funded by the Swiss Federal Office for the Environment, under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as one zip of CSV files (about 1.9 GB). Coverage is Switzerland. Caveats: leap days are removed, values are catchment averages, and alpine catchments are excluded. For simulation it gives compound drought scenarios for crop water stress, irrigation, hydropower and water supply planning. Related catalogue records include the EDO Combined Drought Indicator and the India DroughtSet.
